meta.title: ANATOMICA integumentary system inventory — Milestone 15
meta.source_tables: data/sources/bodyparts3d-4.0/ (BP3D 4.0 / FMA concept ids and names as released)
meta.counting_convention: One record for the skin, keyed on its both-table concept; one record for the hair class with its parent class (skin appendage) carried as class_concept_id; one record each for hair of head, hair of trunk and pubic hair, keyed on their own concepts; one record for the eyebrow with its set class (set of facial hairs) carried. Grouping classes — the integumentary system root, the integument, the subdivision of epidermis and the set of hairs — are censused, never records. Line is censused per concept and per record: skin (one concept), appendage (nine) and system (the two PART-OF roots). The system's whole universe is twelve concepts: the release carries the skin as one whole-body shell and the hair as four mesh files' worth of concepts, and carries no layer, nail, cutaneous gland or mammary concept at all — those structures exist in this module only as sourced clinical records with the absence recorded (the Milestone 9/14 pattern). The mammary gland's ownership is adjudicated in this module's clinical tranche: the release files it under neither system (zero hits under every name), and this module owns the record on the modified-sweat-gland basis stated there.

milestone_14_reproductive.fact: pubic hair (FMA54319) is filed in PART-OF under the mons pubis (FMA20218); the mons pubis is the reproductive module's record 'mons-pubis', keyed on that concept

totalsegmentator_overlap.note: of the 104 TotalSegmentator v1 labels (Milestone 3 census), exactly one is integument-adjacent: 'face', a mask of the facial region — adjudicated below as a region mask, not skin anatomy. No skin or body-surface label exists in TS v1, so the module's TS overlap is zero labels mapped to records
totalsegmentator_overlap.adjudication: the one TS v1 label matched by the integumentary terms is 'face' — a region mask of the face (an imaging region in all 1,204 subjects), not a skin structure: it names no skin, layer or appendage. No 'skin', 'body_trunc', 'body_extremities' or other body-surface label exists in the v1.0 label set — the package class map, the Milestone 3 index census and labels.json agree on the same 104 labels, and none is a skin or body-surface segmentation

absences.note: probe-based gap analysis: each substring probe was counted over all six BP3D 4.0 release tables (zero hits = the name does not occur in the release); each exact-name probe was tested for a concept of exactly that name in either parts list. Present controls are interleaved to prove the instrument reads the tables. 'dermis' is probed by exact name only: as a substring it is contained in 'epidermis' and would read the subdivision class as a false present. The finding is total: beyond the skin shell and the hair concepts, every structure the clinical layer names — layers, strata, nails, follicles, cutaneous glands, sensory corpuscles, the mammary gland — is absent from the release

records.name: skin
records.note: the module's organ record, keyed on the both-table concept. The release gives the skin no IS-A children and no PART-OF parts: no regional skin, no layers — its single mesh (FJ2810) is the whole-body shell the PART-OF table also files under integument and under the integumentary system root itself

records.name: hair
records.note: the hair class record; its parent class, skin appendage (FMA71012), is carried as class_concept_id. The class carries both hair files ({FJ2813, FJ2815}) — exactly the union of its regional records' files

records.name: hair of head
records.note: regional record, keyed on its own concept under the hair class; the only regional hair with its own mesh file (FJ2813)

records.name: hair of trunk
records.note: regional record, keyed on its own concept under the hair class; shares its single mesh file (FJ2815) with its child, pubic hair

records.name: pubic hair
records.note: regional record, keyed on its own concept; the one concept filed across a module boundary — IS-A under hair of trunk here, PART-OF under the mons pubis (FMA20218), the reproductive module's only female record (Milestone 14). Owned here; the cross-filing is gated by the checker against the reproductive inventory

records.name: eyebrow
records.note: the only named facial hair the release carries; keyed on its own concept under set of facial hairs (FMA70741), carried as class_concept_id. The eyebrow, its set class and the set of hairs above it all resolve to the same single mesh file (FJ2812), so the classes carry no geometry beyond this record's. There is no eyelash concept in the release (exact-name probe-verified)
